stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
# Reconstruct the received demonstration exactly from its row descriptions.
inp=[[5]*30 for _ in range(30)]
for c in [12,14]: inp[1 if c==12 else 27][c]=3
for r,a in [(5,20),(8,20),(13,22),(21,6)]:
    inp[r]=[1]*30
    inp[r][a:a+3]=[8]*3
out=[row[:] for row in inp]
def draw(grid, points, color):
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(points,points[1:]):
        if r1==r2:
            for c in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1): grid[r1][c]=color
        else:
            for r in range(min(r1,r2),max(r1,r2)+1): grid[r][c1]=color
# Route above every horizontal bar, through its center.
draw(out,[(1,12),(4,12),(4,21),(5,21),(7,21),(7,21),(8,21),(12,21),(12,23),(13,23),(20,23),(20,7),(21,7),(27,7),(27,14)],3)
pair={'input':inp,'output':out}
(progdir/'task-9da8d2c5.json').write_text(json.dumps([pair]))
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    dots = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,) and all(grid[r][c] != x for x in ())]
    # Isolated non-background cells away from the full-width rows are the endpoints.
    bars = []
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = Counter(row)
        line_color, n = colors.most_common(1)[0]
        if n >= w-3 and line_color != bg:
            mark = next(c for c in colors if c != line_color)
            cs = [c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x == mark]
            bars.append((r, cs[len(cs)//2]))
    endpoints = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if grid[r][c] != bg and not any(r == br for br,_ in bars)]
    endpoints.sort()
    color = grid[endpoints[0][0]][endpoints[0][1]]
    points = [endpoints[0]]
    for r,c in bars:
        points.extend([(r-1, points[-1][1]), (r-1,c), (r,c)])
    points.extend([(endpoints[-1][0], points[-1][1]), endpoints[-1]])
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(points,points[1:]):
        if r1 == r2:
            for c in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1): out[r1][c] = color
        else:
            for r in range(min(r1,r2),max(r1,r2)+1): out[r][c1] = color
    return out
'''

def route_output(inp, color, bars, start, end, final_offset=0):
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    pts=[start]
    for br,bc in bars:
        pts += [(br-1,pts[-1][1]),(br-1,bc),(br,bc)]
    pts += [(end[0]+final_offset,pts[-1][1]),(end[0]+final_offset,end[1])]
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
        if r1==r2:
            for c in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1): out[r1][c]=color
        else:
            for r in range(min(r1,r2),max(r1,r2)+1): out[r][c1]=color
    return out

def make_pair(bg,line,mark,color,bars,start,end,final_offset=0):
    g=[[bg]*30 for _ in range(30)]

    for r,a in bars:

    centers=[(r,a+1) for r,a in bars]
    return {'input':g,'output':route_output(g,color,centers,start,end,final_offset)}
